clue.description: A 4 by 4 Sudoku: each row, column, and 2 by 2 box holds 1 to 4. These are the given digits; 0 is an empty cell.

constraints.name: box
constraints.all_different: [cell[r,c] | r in N, c in N: 2 * div(r - 1, 2) + div(c - 1, 2) + 1 == b]

constraints.name: given
constraints.forall: r in N, c in N: clue[r,c] > 0
constraints.description: Asking for two solutions ("solutions": 2) tells whether the puzzle is well posed: a complete result with one solution means it is the only one.
